Author: Guiraut_dEspaigna
Title: Ben volgra, sesser poges
FullText: E per que? Car per plaser
Del joy don ieu tant sospir . . .
Quel reys Karles fay gent chan,
Per aquo as el ti man,
Car de fin pres es apres.
